intention: Manual charge create form always captures a location and auto-selects the right vehicle (single -> disabled; else first OWNER; else first-in-list).
request: I want some improvements on the manualcharge module: (1) make location_kind a required field on the charge form (front-end and back-end); (2) auto-select the vehicle in the create form - single vehicle -> auto-select + disable; more than one -> first vehicle with Tesla access_type OWNER.

decisions.decision: location_kind -> NOT NULL via defensive backfill to 'OTHER' then SET NOT NULL, no DB DEFAULT; required on create+edit; domain field stays *string, validated non-nil.
decisions.why: Grill-me outcome; keeps build green after the manualcharge tier and preserves the DB-boundary nil convention.

decisions.decision: vehicles.access_type nullable TEXT, CHECK (IS NULL OR IN ('OWNER','DRIVER')), no index; AccessType *string on Vehicle/OwnedVehicle/SeedVehicle.
decisions.why: Grill-me outcome; no truthful backfill value for a migration, read only within the small per-account vehicle list.

decisions.decision: No access_type backfill mechanism: user wipes all DB table data, so fresh seeds capture access_type. Wipe must happen after tesla+account tiers deploy.
decisions.why: Grill-me outcome; collapses the SeedVehicles ON CONFLICT change and gateway re-seed trigger.

decisions.decision: Auto-select is create-form only: single -> select + disabled + hidden input; else first OWNER; else first-in-list; never unselected.
decisions.why: Grill-me outcome; disabled <select> posts nothing, so a hidden input carries the value.

tiers.notes: Add AccessType to VehicleTesla DTO; no DB, no new Fleet call.
Add access_type column + domain fields; persist on seed. DB design gate.
location_kind NOT NULL + service validation. DB design gate.
Required location field + create-form vehicle auto-select; map access_type at seed.
